append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1639). PREMISE RE-TESTED on this tree: joinRoom selected id and visibility only, refused private, and upserted a room_members row through the admin client for everything else, so the probe failed naming SEC-5. SHIPPED: joinRoom reads scope_id with visibility. A public room stays open to anyone signed in. A private room still needs an invite. A circle, hub, nexus, outpost or channel room asks belongsToRoomScope before the upsert (active memberships row, or the Circle host / Hub guide / Nexus mentor; a Channel asks topical_channel_memberships). Missing scope_id, a missing scope row, an inactive membership, or an unknown visibility is a plain refusal. No migration. PROBE: failed on this tree before the change; passes here. Tests: lib/messages/room-scope.test.ts, one case per visibility.
